PROJECT_NAME.description: Display name of the adopting project.

OWNER_ROLE.description: Who decides major product and architecture changes.

ARCHITECTURE_AUTHORITY.description: Who maintains canonical architecture with the owner.

SUPERVISOR_AGENT.description: Agent that owns roadmap, Goals, Specs, reviews and progress.

IMPLEMENTER_AGENT.description: Agent that owns Plans, implementation, validation and Results.

CANONICAL_SOURCES.description: Repository files read before planning, implementing or reviewing.

SERVICE_ROOTS.description: Service directories with scoped instructions; empty when none.

INTEGRATION_BRANCH.description: Long-lived branch that receives reviewed merge requests and supervisor publications; set explicitly.

SUPERVISOR_AUTO_PUBLISH.description: Whether the supervisor commits and pushes each completed PROGRESS update and its management records to the integration branch (true by default; the owner may disable it).

PROTECTED_BRANCHES.description: Long-lived branches that are never deleted or rewritten.

PRE_BATCH_ENV_CHECK.description: Optional environment safeguard run before every batch; empty when none.

FINAL_VALIDATION_PLACEMENT.description: local-after-merge (default): coordinator runs affected suites locally after reviewed merge; full local tip runs are owner-requested or supervisor-recommended. RC MRs retain full hosted qualification; other placements require explicit adoption.

CANCELED_PIPELINE_SATISFIES.description: Whether an owner-canceled post-merge pipeline satisfies the gate.

DEFAULT_BUDGET.description: Default Goal budget class: B3, B5, B7 or B15.

COORDINATOR_EFFORT.description: Recommended coordinator effort for orchestration, status and handoffs (planning uses PLANNING_EFFORT).

OBSERVER_AUTO_ACTIVATE.description: Start the companion milestone observer after the coordinator and supervisor bindings are explicitly established and verified (true by default; independent of supervisor publication).

PLANNING_EFFORT.description: Recommended planning effort; a recommendation, not a verified setting.

IMPLEMENTATION_EFFORT.description: Recommended implementation effort; a recommendation, not a verified setting.

DELIVERY_BARRIER.description: Optional roadmap delivery barrier declared by the project; empty when none.

CODEX_CONFIG_TEMPLATE.description: Render the optional repository-scoped .codex/config.toml (opt-in; an existing file gets a .sdlc-proposed draft; account-wide settings are never edited).

CODEX_MAIN_MODEL.description: Main-session Codex model in the optional .codex/config.toml; sessions may override it.

CODEX_MAIN_EFFORT.description: Main-session Codex reasoning effort in the optional .codex/config.toml.

CODEX_SUBAGENT_MODEL.description: Default Codex subagent model in the optional .codex/config.toml; per-spawn overrides take precedence.

CODEX_SUBAGENT_EFFORT.description: Default Codex subagent reasoning effort in the optional .codex/config.toml.
